explication: Resilience4j is a modular Java fault-tolerance library. An application supplies a synchronous or asynchronous backend operation, creates one or more resilience policies, and decorates or directly executes that operation; the protected call either returns a result or invokes fallback behavior. The sampled sources confirm circuit-breaker, rate-limiter, Feign, executor, context propagation, fallback, and hedge internals. Retry, timeout, annotations, configuration, cache, and event/metrics breadth are represented from the README and tree, but their detailed wiring was not sampled.
